sources.title: Hermes 3 - NOUS RESEARCH
sources.snippet: Hermes 3 contains advanced long-term context retention and multi-turn conversation capability, complex roleplaying and internal monologue abilities, and enhanced agentic function-calling. Our training data aggressively encourages the model to follow the system and instruction prompts exactly and in an adaptive manner. sources.title: Hermes Agent — Open-Source AI Agent That Grows With You | Nous Research
sources.snippet: Hermes Agent is the open-source, self-hosted AI agent by Nous Research. Persistent memory, self-created skills, and a messaging gateway for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and more. Download Hermes Desktop for macOS and Windows, or install via terminal on Linux — free under the MIT license.

sources.title: Hermes Agent — Open-Source AI Agent with Memory, Skills, and Cron
sources.snippet: Hermes Agent is the open-source AI agent from Nous Research with persistent memory, reusable skills, cron jobs, tools, and multi-platform messaging.
